- Annotators rated NMs using four binary metrics: relevance, fluency, validity, and factual consistency.
Annotators rate each generated nonverbal message on relevance to the utterance, fluency of the phrase, validity (whether it fits a NM type), and factual consistency with the context.

we ask annotators to rate each NM using the following four binary metrics: (M1) the relevance between the utterance and the NM based on the context, (M2) the fluency of the NM, (M3) the validity of the NM, and (M4) the factual consistency of the NM based on the context and utterance.
